plugins.name: foresight
plugins.description: Strategic futures thinking and content production. Nine modes (Signal Scan, Scenario, Forecast, Artifact, Implications, Challenge, Backcast, Investment Memo, Historical Pattern), six interaction styles including a plain-language guide for newcomers and a headless style for automation, and a persistent signal database with automated pattern detection and a visual dashboard. Grounded in IFTF, Stanford d.school and structured analytic technique methodology.
